## Plot for Count or Proportion of Various Categorical Predictors (stack vs dodge)

ggplot(Student_Sex_by_country, aes(x = Country, y = Count, fill = Sex)) + geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +  labs(x = "Country", y = "NUmber of Students", title = "Number of sudents by Country and Sex") + scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Blues", name = "Level") + theme_bw()
